This looks like a square plate of about 24 cm, holding three foods plus a little avocado.

- **Mashed sweet potato:** about 120 g at roughly 90 kcal per 100 g, so about 110 kcal.
- **Tuna salad:** about 130 g. With mayo, celery and onion it runs about 190 kcal per 100 g, so about 250 kcal.
- **Shredded carrot:** about 80 g at 41 kcal per 100 g, so about 33 kcal.
- **Avocado:** about 40 g at 160 kcal per 100 g, so about 65 kcal.

Together that comes to roughly 370 g and 460 kcal.
